claim.quote: Considering spin-independent dark matter-nucleon scattering, we exclude cross sections \sigma_n>3.5x10^{-42} cm^2, for a dark matter particle mass m_{\chi}=8 GeV.

key_value.note: Spin-independent limit as stated, at a dark matter mass of 8 GeV.
key_value.quote: \sigma_n>3.5x10^{-42} cm^2, for a dark matter particle mass m_{\chi}=8 GeV

name: A search for light dark matter in XENON10 data

summary.plain: Re-analysing old XENON10 data with a single-electron threshold, the team probed very light dark matter and found it in tension with claimed signals from other experiments.
summary.technical: Trigger sensitive to a single electron; analysis threshold of 5 electrons, corresponding to 1.4 keV nuclear recoil energy; excludes sigma_n > 3.5e-42 cm^2 at m_chi = 8 GeV. The abstract states that the data strongly constrain recent elastic dark matter interpretations of excess events observed by CoGeNT and CRESST-II, as well as the DAMA annual modulation signal.

title: A search for light dark matter in XENON10 data
why_it_matters: Opened the light dark matter window to xenon detectors, a method later used by other experiments.
